boundary.description: From the junction of Glen Avenue and Clough Road, W along Glen Avenue, Gill Street, Oak Bank Avenue, by a beeline to and along Blue Bell Avenue, Moston Lane, Millais Street, and by a bee-line to Lightbowne Road and Arbory Avenue (both sides in St Dunstan’s parish), to Joyce Street, St Mary’s Road to the point where it crosses the railway. W along the railway to and NW along Thorp Road, and along a footpath through Moston Vale to Carisbrook Street and its junction with Conran Street. NE along Conran Street and footpath to and W along Church Lane, Hillier Street to the point opposite Hillier Street North. N along Hillier Street North to and E along Moston Lane and N along Clough Lane to its junction with Glen Avenue.
